common.data_unavailable: Data unavailable right now — retry in a moment.
common.offline: No internet connection. Cached data still shows; check your network and retry.
common.rate_limited: Yahoo Finance is rate-limiting requests right now. Cached data still shows; fresh quotes usually return within a few minutes.
common.sign_in: Sign in to see your own book.
common.storage_restore_failed: Cloud storage is unreachable, so sign-in was halted to protect your data. Retry in a few minutes.
common.sync_failed: Cloud sync failed — change kept on this device for now.
common.toast_offline: No connection to the data provider — some figures are missing.
common.toast_rate_limited: Yahoo Finance is rate-limiting — some figures are missing. Usually clears in a few minutes.
common.legacy_banner: This is the **previous version** of TopStocks, kept for reference only. It reads and writes the same data as the app, so change things in [the app](/) rather than here.
